notes.title: Statement of Purifications from the Sanctuary
notes.content:
Hello, friends from the otherworld!
We want to announce that we was completed an update on the August 27 2021.
The contents are as stated below.


Elf Costumes
・Added 2 Default costume.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/1a3ffa989c2cd1b6ce105ee5d5f455eb39b5cca4.jpg

難易度
・Adjusted the appearance frequency of dragons on the cliff stage.

改善
・Addition of a function that allows you to check the reward list from the menu.


Addition of a function that allows you to view the reward list from the menu

For Future Updates
・Added single-player stage.
・Added multiplayer stage.
・Added elf race.
・Added elf costume.
・Added multiplayer avatar.


Thank you for your continuous support!

notes.title: Statement of Purifications from the Sanctuary
notes.content:
Hello, friends from the otherworld!
We want to announce that we was completed an update on the July 16, 2021.
The contents are as stated below.


Elf Costumes
・Added 2 default costume.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/8732f6a440bdffac54babca8174724122929c3c7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/2a40d7fbb0b2f504513238bf42fc227907e93631.jpg


Cut Scenes
・Added skip function.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/03fb3eaf035af64b5ef425d8d637f2b18a6d6edb.jpg


Difficulty
・Adjusted all creatures weakness target size.
・Adjusted the damage of some creatures.


Background
・Adjusted the degree of purifications.
・Reduced grass models on all stages.


Improvement
・Add trajectory function.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/c8b35757c6321cd487a528ccf30a0d395384ce12.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/ea24b1c37b4ffc3510113b4e46fb6261788c12b4.jpg

・Fix the pause UI so it will appears after moving.

・Changed WAVE notification.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/d0d717e66081e8748a385a617e7a1d0fecf307c8.jpg


Bug
・Fixed save timing.
・Fixed Elf default facial expression. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/c104b8e1bdc1e3798f6bdcf4945ec7081bb0c6fc.png

Scheduled to be updated next month.
・Added  special goblin to「Ancient Forest」.
・Added  special merman to「Canyon of Life」.
・Added 2 default costume.
・Improved UI

For Future Updates
・Added single-player stage.

・Added elf race.
・Added elf costume.
・Added multiplayer avatar.


Thank you for your continuous support!
